buildEquivalence.source: DeepSeek changelog: from 12:00 Beijing 2026-09-14, requests to deepseek-v4-pro are routed to V4.1 Flash at Flash pricing (until V4.1 Pro ships). Served-build identity is server-side and not locally observable; this set is the enforceable proxy.

notes: Ordered preference: the first SOLVENT+REACHABLE candidate wins; if none is solvent or reachable the gate is DEGRADED and fails closed (never dispatch the tool default or any build-equivalent model as an 'independent' review).
kimi-k3 first honours the human's 2026-09-11 selection; opus-4.8 second. Funding either account (or adding a candidate) needs no code change — this file is the single source of truth.

Do NOT re-add a candidate whose funding is unverified: re-check the dated evidence in the #716 funding comment (probe results are recorded there, never frozen into this shipped file) before adding qwen-tp, zai, or any other previously-unfunded model back.
costCentsPerPass is an integer-cents estimate per 40K-in/4K-out review pass (kept off the USD-literal shape #701's AC1 grep scans for).

runtimeVia names the dispatch authority. pi's openrouter model list lives in TypeScript (extensions/custom-provider-openrouter) and is not machine-readable from scripts/ — dispatchability is proven end-to-end by one real graded gate run (indicator (c)); see #734.
buildEquivalence is reversible: when V4.1 Pro ships, remove the pro entries (both normalized + the family regex alternative) so the reroute mapping does not outlive the reroute.
